channel.title: CW Headlines · 25 WPM
channel.description: The day's top ten news stories, sent in Morse code, at 25 WPM. A new edition every morning: ten short summaries of the top stories on the BBC News front page, sent as clean 600 Hz CW. The full plain-text copy is in each episode's notes so you can check what you copied. Not affiliated with the BBC.

item.title: 7 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 7 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 THOMAS MARKLE, 82, FATHER OF MEGHAN, APPEARS IN COURT OVER CHILD SEX ABUSE MATERIAL AFTER HIS ARREST IN FLORIDA FOLLOWING AN FBI SEARCH. <BT> Story

1:19 NR 2 PRESIDENT TRUMP NAMES STEPHEN MILLER AS HIS NEW CHIEF OF STAFF, A CHOICE LIKELY TO SET UP CLASHES WITH CONGRESS. <BT> Story

2:07 NR 3 A MAYOR IN TEXAS TELLS POLICE TO LIMIT COOPERATION WITH ICE, INFORMING THE AGENCY ONLY ABOUT PEOPLE ARRESTED FOR JAILABLE OFFENCES. <BT> Story

3:06 NR 4 BRAND'S BARRISTER IAN WINTER REFERS HIMSELF TO THE REGULATOR AFTER REPORTEDLY CONFRONTING A REPORTER WHO HAD INVESTIGATED THE COMEDIAN. <BT> Story

4:03 NR 5 THE UK HAS A PLAN FOR A BLACK SKY EVENT, WHICH COULD CUT POWER, WATER AND COMMUNICATIONS TO MILLIONS OF PEOPLE. <BT> Story

4:55 NR 6 MARRIED AT FIRST SIGHT UK HAS BEEN CANCELLED AFTER A BBC PANORAMA INVESTIGATION, AND CAST MEMBERS REACT WITH RELIEF, TEARS AND SADNESS. <BT> Story

5:51 NR 7 KIERNAN DEWSBURY-HALL ANSWERS HIS ENGLAND OMISSION WITH A SUPERB GOAL AS EVERTON COME FROM BEHIND TO BEAT COVENTRY CITY 3-1. <BT> Story

6:46 NR 8 A GLADIATOR II STUNTMAN, EDWARD SARSFIELD, SUES OVER SEVERE BURNS HE SAYS HE SUFFERED IN AN EXPLOSION WHILE FILMING ON A BURNING SHIP. <BT> Story

7:44 NR 9 DOVER MP MIKE TAPP SAYS A LAUNCH FROM THE NETHERLANDS SHOWS PEOPLE SMUGGLERS ARE ADAPTING AND WILL FIND NEW METHODS AND LOCATIONS. <BT> Story

8:40 NR 10 PARAGUAY'S PRESIDENT SANTIAGO PENA IS IMPEACHED AND REMOVED AFTER A BANK COLLAPSE LEFT MILLIONS OF PEOPLE UNABLE TO REACH THEIR MONEY. <AR> Story

item.title: 6 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 6 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 GLOBAL TECHNOLOGY SHARES FALL SHARPLY, AS INVESTORS WORRY THAT THE US MIDTERM RESULTS COULD BRING TOUGHER SCRUTINY OF DATA CENTRES AND THE AI INDUSTRY. <BT> Story

1:24 NR 2 METROPOLITAN POLICE CHIEF SIR MARK ROWLEY WILL WARN THAT POLICING IS HEADING FOR FAILURE WITHOUT REFORM, SAYING IT CANNOT COPE WITH SOPHISTICATED MODERN CRIMINALS. <BT> Story

2:37 NR 3 POLICE SAY RUSSELL BRAND IS BEING INVESTIGATED OVER TWO NEW RAPE COMPLAINTS, AND HOPE THE GUILTY VERDICTS WILL ENCOURAGE OTHER POTENTIAL VICTIMS. <BT> Story

3:39 NR 4 EMPLOYERS ARE TOLD TO INCLUDE SALARIES IN JOB ADVERTS BEFORE A NEW LAW, WITH THE GOVERNMENT SAYING IT WILL HELP JOBSEEKERS AND CURB PAY DISCRIMINATION. <BT> Story

4:44 NR 5 THE GOVERNOR OF CALIFORNIA COMMUTES THE SENTENCES OF ALL 548 PEOPLE ON THE STATE'S DEATH ROW, HISTORICALLY THE LARGEST IN THE US. <BT> Story

5:41 NR 6 LABOUR IS WEAKENING MARGARET THATCHER'S RIGHT TO BUY HOUSING POLICY, RAISING QUESTIONS OVER WHETHER THE CHANGE WILL FIX BRITAIN'S SOCIAL HOUSING PROBLEMS. <BT> Story

6:50 NR 7 THE WHITE HOUSE DENIES THAT HEGSETH AND RUBIO WILL LEAVE THEIR POSTS AFTER REPUBLICAN ELECTION LOSSES, AMID CALLS TO REPLACE HEGSETH, WHO FACES POSSIBLE IMPEACHMENT. <BT> Story

7:59 NR 8 TRUMP SIGNS AN ORDER TO STOP FUTURE PRESIDENTS ALTERING THE OVAL OFFICE, AFTER HIS MAJOR CHANGES TO ITS DECOR AND DEMOLITION OF THE EAST WING. <BT> Story

8:59 NR 9 A POLICE CAR IS SET ON FIRE IN GLASGOW AS BONFIRE NIGHT DISORDER IN SCOTLAND LEADS TO SEVEN ARRESTS AND FIREWORKS THROWN AT EMERGENCY WORKERS. <BT> Story

9:59 NR 10 A PALACE AIDE SAYS THE KING RELISHES POLITICALLY CHARGED TRIPS, AFTER FACING QUESTIONS OVER UK INVOLVEMENT IN THE SLAVE TRADE DURING HIS CARIBBEAN TOUR. <AR> Story

item.title: 5 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 5 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:17 NR 1 VICE-PRESIDENT VANCE GIVES A BLUNT ASSESSMENT OF THE REPUBLICAN ELECTION DEFEAT, BLAMING THE IRAN WAR IN A SHARP BREAK WITH THE PRESIDENT. <BT> Story

1:14 NR 2 THE UK COMMITS TO TIME-LIMITED TALKS ON AN APOLOGY FOR SLAVERY, THOUGH NO DATE HAS YET BEEN CONFIRMED FOR DEALING WITH THE ISSUE. <BT> Story

2:11 NR 3 THE NHS IS LEANING INCREASINGLY ON CHARITIES, RAISING QUESTIONS OVER WHETHER THIS SIGNALS A STRAINED HEALTH SERVICE OR USEFUL PUBLIC INVOLVEMENT. <BT> Story

3:11 NR 4 JOSHUA WONG, 30, A FACE OF HONG KONG PRO-DEMOCRACY PROTESTS, IS JAILED FOR 10 YEARS. HUNDREDS HAVE BEEN DETAINED UNDER THE NATIONAL SECURITY LAW. <BT> Story

4:19 NR 5 INTEREST RATES ARE EXPECTED TO RISE FROM 3.75 PERCENT TO 4 PERCENT, MOST ANALYSTS PREDICT, THE FIRST INCREASE IN MORE THAN THREE YEARS. <BT> Story

5:15 NR 6 TYPHOONS STRIKE EAST ASIA AS EL NINO HEATS THE PACIFIC, BRINGING UNUSUALLY WILD WEATHER OVER RECENT MONTHS EVEN TO TYPHOON-HARDENED COUNTRIES. <BT> Story

6:16 NR 7 THE POUND CLIMBS TO ITS HIGHEST LEVEL AGAINST A BASKET OF CURRENCIES SINCE THE BREXIT REFERENDUM A DECADE AGO. <BT> Story

7:02 NR 8 A BRITISH MAN INFECTED WITH EBOLA IN DR CONGO WILL BE FLOWN BACK TO THE UK, WHILE THE GOVERNMENT SAYS PUBLIC RISK REMAINS LOW. <BT> Story

7:57 NR 9 MORE ASBESTOS IS FOUND IN PARLIAMENT AS MPS ARE URGED TO DECIDE ON REFURBISHMENT, AMID WARNINGS OF A FIRE LIKE NOTRE DAME. <BT> Story

8:48 NR 10 POLICE SCOTLAND WILL ESCORT FIRE CREWS ON BONFIRE NIGHT, WITH UP TO 1,700 OFFICERS POSSIBLY DEPLOYED IN ITS BIGGEST OPERATION SINCE PRESIDENT TRUMP VISITED LAST YEAR. <AR> Story

item.title: 4 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 4 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 VOTES ARE BEING COUNTED IN THE US MIDTERM ELECTIONS, AND EARLY RESULTS POINT TO GAINS FOR THE DEMOCRATS. <BT> Story

1:02 NR 2 FOREIGN SECRETARY MILIBAND SAYS A UK APOLOGY FOR SLAVERY WILL NOT COST TAXPAYERS, ADDING THAT BRITAIN CANNOT HIDE FROM ITS PAST. <BT> Story

2:00 NR 3 SOME GP SURGERIES WILL SOON OFFER MULTI-CANCER BLOOD TESTS, AIMING TO CATCH LIVER, OVARIAN AND PANCREATIC CANCERS MUCH EARLIER. <BT> Story

2:57 NR 4 A POUNDLAND SUPPLIER SAYS IT WILL LOSE MILLIONS IF THE RETAILER COLLAPSES, WHILE OTHER SUPPLIERS WARN THEY WOULD GO OUT OF BUSINESS. <BT> Story

3:56 NR 5 SCAMMERS ARE USING AI-GENERATED PICTURES OF MISSING PETS TO DEMAND REWARD MONEY, WITH SOME OWNERS THREATENED THAT THEIR CATS WOULD BE KILLED. <BT> Story

4:54 NR 6 KELLOGG'S IS DROPPING RICE GRAINS FROM RICE KRISPIES BECAUSE OF CHANGING WEATHER, AND PACKS WILL NOW CARRY A WHEAT GLUTEN WARNING. <BT> Story

5:53 NR 7 SPAIN'S TRANSPORT MINISTER HAS RESIGNED DAYS AFTER A TRAIN COLLISION SOUTH OF MADRID KILLED AT LEAST 69 PEOPLE AND INJURED DOZENS. <BT> Story

6:50 NR 8 ANDREW MOUNTBATTEN-WINDSOR HAS BEEN SUMMONSED TO GIVE EVIDENCE IN DECEMBER AT A BUSINESSMAN'S FRAUD TRIAL IN THE HIGH COURT. <BT> Story

7:42 NR 9 KIM KARDASHIAN EXPLAINS HER RETURN FOR A SECOND SERIES OF THE DRAMA ALL'S FAIR, SAYING SHE HAS WORKED ON HER ACTING. <BT> Story

8:32 NR 10 THE CODE OF A BRASS PADLOCK FOUND NEAR PORT TALBOT, PART OF A TREASURE HOARD FROM A 1583 SHIPWRECK, HAS BEEN CRACKED. <AR> Story

item.title: 3 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 3 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 AMERICANS VOTE IN MIDTERM ELECTIONS THAT WILL SHAPE CONGRESS FOR THE FINAL YEARS OF TRUMP'S PRESIDENCY AND TEST POLITICS BEYOND HIM. <BT> Story

1:15 NR 2 THE US CARRIES OUT STRIKES ON IRAN'S QESHM ISLAND BEFORE THE MIDTERMS, WITH OFFICIALS CALLING THE ATTACKS LIMITED AND DEFENSIVE, CBS REPORTS. <BT> Story

2:15 NR 3 THE UK AND EU REACH A DRAFT DEAL CUTTING BREXIT PAPERWORK ON FOOD EXPORTS, THE BIGGEST PART OF THE RESET SO FAR. <BT> Story

3:03 NR 4 THOUSANDS OF EUROPEAN TROOPS WILL REHEARSE A UKRAINE DEPLOYMENT IN THE EVENT OF PEACE, AND OFFICIALS SAY THE FORCE WOULD NOT JOIN OFFENSIVE OPERATIONS. <BT> Story

4:09 NR 5 THE PRIME MINISTER PLANS A DEBT RESET FOR COMMONWEALTH NATIONS AS TALKS BEGIN ON A FORMAL UK APOLOGY FOR THE SLAVE TRADE WITHIN A YEAR. <BT> Story

5:06 NR 6 INVESTIGATORS SAY A JET MAY HAVE BROKEN UP BEFORE ITS DEADLY CRASH IN FLORIDA, AND WEATHER COULD BE A FACTOR, THOUGH THE CAUSE IS NOT YET KNOWN. <BT> Story

6:09 NR 7 A WATCHDOG INVESTIGATION OF 25 ITEMS FROM ONLINE SITES INCLUDING AMAZON AND TEMU FINDS JEWELLERY SOLD AS STERLING SILVER CONTAINING TOXIC CHEMICALS. <BT> Story

7:13 NR 8 HOME SECRETARY MAHMOOD DROPS SETTLEMENT PLANS FOR MIGRANT CARE WORKERS AND SETS OUT A REVISED PROPOSAL ON WHEN MIGRANTS CAN GAIN PERMANENT RESIDENCY. <BT> Story

8:16 NR 9 NORTH KOREA DENIES CARRYING OUT THE RECORD 6.3 BILLION DOLLAR HACK OF BINANCE, WHICH US AGENCIES AND CYBER ANALYSTS HAVE BLAMED ON PYONGYANG. <BT> Story

9:21 NR 10 COLLINS NAMES MOGGING, A SLANG TERM FOR OUTSHINING OR UPSTAGING SOMEONE, AS ITS WORD OF THE YEAR AMONG 10 WORDS CELEBRATED. <AR> Story

item.title: 2 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 2 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 FIVE TEENAGERS WERE STABBED AT A HALLOWEEN PARTY IN CHANDLER'S FORD, AND HAMPSHIRE POLICE BELIEVE AN UNKNOWN GROUP GOT INTO THE ADDRESS. <BT> Story

1:17 NR 2 NINE PEOPLE DIED WHEN A JET CRASHED IN FLAMES IN FLORIDA NEAR PRESIDENT TRUMP'S MAR-A-LAGO RESORT, WHICH TRANSPORTATION SECRETARY SEAN DUFFY CALLED A TERRIBLE TRAGEDY. <BT> Story

2:29 NR 3 VIRGIN MEDIA O2 PLANS TO CUT THOUSANDS OF JOBS, THOUGH THE BROADBAND FIRM HAS NOT YET SETTLED ON THE EXACT NUMBER OF ROLES. <BT> Story

3:23 NR 4 A ROW AMONG DEMOCRATS IN DETROIT, MICHIGAN HAS SHAKEN THE PARTY JUST DAYS BEFORE THE US MIDTERM ELECTIONS, BBC'S NADA TAWFIK REPORTS. <BT> Story

4:22 NR 5 KIMI ANTONELLI IS THE YOUNGEST FORMULA 1 WORLD CHAMPION EVER AFTER CLINCHING THE TITLE AS MAX VERSTAPPEN WON THE MEXICO CITY GRAND PRIX. <BT> Story

5:21 NR 6 A NEW WARNING SYSTEM IN A AND E DEPARTMENTS IN ENGLAND WILL HELP STAFF SPOT CHILDREN WHOSE CONDITION WORSENS QUICKLY WHILE AWAITING EMERGENCY CARE. <BT> Story

6:23 NR 7 KING CHARLES III WILL SPEAK ON SLAVERY IN ANTIGUA ON TUESDAY, ENDING HIS CARIBBEAN TOUR, WITH THE PRIME MINISTER OPEN TO A POSSIBLE UK APOLOGY. <BT> Story

7:25 NR 8 OLYMPIAN CIARA MAGEEAN, A FORMER EUROPEAN 1500 METRES CHAMPION, HAS DIED OF BOWEL CANCER AT 34, THREE WEEKS AFTER MARRYING HER PARTNER. <BT> Story

8:27 NR 9 ADVENTURER KARL BUSHBY CROSSED THE HUMBER BRIDGE NEAR THE END OF A 28-YEAR, 31,000-MILE JOURNEY AROUND THE WORLD, DUE TO FINISH IN HULL ON MONDAY. <BT> Story

9:36 NR 10 BINANCE USERS PULLED OUT 3.6 BILLION DOLLARS AFTER A RECORD CRYPTO HACK AFFECTING 6.3 BILLION DOLLARS IN DIGITAL ASSETS, AND THE EXCHANGE FROZE TRANSACTIONS. <AR> Story

item.title: 1 Nov 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 1 NOV 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 COST OF LIVING PROTESTS IN GERMANY TURN VIOLENT, WITH SHOPS LOOTED IN FRANKFURT AND UNREST REPORTED IN BERLIN, HAMBURG AND COLOGNE. <BT> Story

1:17 NR 2 CHANCELLOR HEALEY SUGGESTS YOUNGER WORKERS MAY NOT GET THE SAME MINIMUM WAGE AS OTHERS BEFORE THE NEXT ELECTION, RISKING A BROKEN PROMISE. <BT> Story

0:18 NR 1 PRESIDENT LULA OF BRAZIL IS RE-ELECTED FOR A FOURTH TERM, EDGING OUT RIGHT-WING CHALLENGER FLAVIO BOLSONARO, SON OF THE FORMER PRESIDENT, IN A CLOSE VOTE. <BT> Story

1:28 NR 2 STORM BOELO CUTS POWER TO ABOUT 90,000 PROPERTIES ACROSS SCOTLAND AND NORTHERN ENGLAND, AND THE MET OFFICE HAS ISSUED A FRESH WIND WARNING. <BT> Story

2:32 NR 3 HEALEY PLANS TO KEEP LOWER-INCOME PENSIONERS OUT OF INCOME TAX IN THE BUDGET, AS THE FULL STATE PENSION IS DUE TO RISE IN APRIL. <BT> Story

3:26 NR 4 A DAUGHTER WHO LOOKED AFTER HER ELDERLY MOTHER AT HOME WINS A CLAIM OF 127,000 POUNDS, AFTER A PAINFUL DISPUTE WITH HER SIBLINGS. <BT> Story

4:25 NR 5 LONDON'S OXFORD STREET HAS BEEN PEDESTRIANISED, AND THE FIRST PHASE OF THE WORK IS DUE TO FINISH BY SPRING 2027. <BT> Story

5:15 NR 6 SENIOR CONSULTANT DOCTORS IN ENGLAND WILL STRIKE FOR 48 HOURS FROM 25 NOVEMBER IN A DISPUTE OVER PAY AND PENSIONS. <BT> Story

6:07 NR 7 SERBIA CELEBRATES AS VETERAN LEADER ALEKSANDAR VUCIC CONCEDES DEFEAT TO A STUDENT-LED PROTEST MOVEMENT AFTER 12 YEARS IN POWER. <BT> Story

7:00 NR 8 PRIME MINISTER BURNHAM DOES NOT RULE OUT A REFERENDUM ON EU FREE MOVEMENT AND WANTS A DEBATE ON THE UK'S FUTURE TIES WITH EUROPE. <BT> Story

7:52 NR 9 VENEZUELAN OPPOSITION LEADER MARIA MACHADO RETURNS TO CHEERING CROWDS AFTER MORE THAN TEN MONTHS IN EXILE, HAVING FLED THE COUNTRY BY SPEEDBOAT. <BT> Story

8:54 NR 10 PRINCE WILLIAM SAYS KNIGHTING RUGBY LEAGUE STAR KEVIN SINFIELD WAS AN EASY DECISION, ADDING THE HONOUR SHOULD HAVE COME YEARS AGO. <AR> Story
